dossier.scp_unleashed.427.caption: SCP-427 at intake, closed, resting on dark cloth.
dossier.scp_unleashed.427.page.0.text.0: SCP-427 is to be kept closed and stored in a standard anomalous item locker. **It is not to be worn, carried for comfort or left open.**
dossier.scp_unleashed.427.page.0.text.1: Use of the object is limited to approved sessions with two attending staff. One of them keeps a running record of every session for every subject, and no subject holds the open locket for longer than the session lead allows.
dossier.scp_unleashed.427.page.0.text.2: Any subject who reports warmth under the skin or a pounding heart is to have the locket taken from them at once. %rThey will ask for it back.%r
dossier.scp_unleashed.427.page.0.title: Special Containment Procedures:
dossier.scp_unleashed.427.page.1.text.0: SCP-427 is a small hinged locket of worn silver, roughly 4 cm across, with a raised rose on its domed cover and fine scrollwork around the rim. It hangs from a short loop of chain. Closed, it cannot be told apart from ordinary jewellery.
dossier.scp_unleashed.427.page.1.text.1: When the cover is opened, a cold blue light spills from a small compartment inside. Subjects holding the open locket describe a deep calm. While it stays open, small injuries close and lingering sickness fades.
dossier.scp_unleashed.427.page.1.text.2: The effect is not free. It appears to build up from one session to the next. Prolonged exposure first brings a prickling warmth beneath the skin, then a heavy, insistent heartbeat. Subjects who carry on past this point undergo a rapid and complete transformation into an instance of SCP-427-1.
dossier.scp_unleashed.427.page.1.text.3: SCP-427-1 instances are large, hostile creatures of pale pink flesh that walk on their long arms. They show no trace of the subject they once were, attack any person nearby and recover from wounds over time.
dossier.scp_unleashed.427.page.1.title: Description:
dossier.scp_unleashed.427.page.2.text.0: Session 427-03: the subject held the open locket for a short session. A cut on one hand closed before the session ended. The subject asked to keep the locket. %rRequest denied.%r
dossier.scp_unleashed.427.page.2.text.1: Session 427-08: the subject reported a warm prickling along both arms and asked to continue. The session lead closed the locket.
dossier.scp_unleashed.427.page.2.text.2: Session 427-11: the record of earlier sessions had been mislaid. %rNobody checked.%r Security answered a call from the testing room shortly afterwards, and one instance of SCP-427-1 was brought down at heavy cost.
dossier.scp_unleashed.427.page.2.title: Addendum 427-1: Session Log
dossier.scp_unleashed.427.page.3.text: SCP-427 has no recovery record. It was delivered to a reader of this file in a small velvet pouch by the unidentified individual in Foundation dress described in the files of other objects. See field notes.
dossier.scp_unleashed.427.page.3.title: Addendum 427-2: Provenance
dossier.scp_unleashed.427.title: Lovecraftian Locket
Hold use with it in your main hand to open it.
A cold, gentle light waits inside.
item.scp_unleashed.scp427_locket.tooltip: A tarnished silver locket with a rose on the cover.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp427_1_spawn_eg: SCP-427-1, a hulking creature of pale pink flesh that walks on its long arms. It hunts the nearest person, lunges across open ground and slams down on anyone close.
Its wounds knit shut over time, so fight it hard or not at all.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp427_locket.1: SCP-427, a tarnished silver locket with a raised rose on the cover. Hold use with it in your main hand and the cover swings open on its hinge. A cold blue light spills out, and the one holding it slowly heals.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp427_locket.2: Prolonged exposure is not safe. Keep sessions short, and keep it shut in a storage locker when it is not needed. It does nothing while shut away or worn closed.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp427_locket.3: It cannot be crafted. Recover the SCP-427 dossier from an Archive Terminal and break its seal. A stranger in Foundation dress will bring the locket to you.

message.scp_unleashed.scp427.warning.2: Your heart pounds against the locket.
